a.text: Being upfront: the 80% storm chance after every round means our plan almost surely fails. We'd need 2 operate rounds plus a take round, so about 4% survival for each of us. I'm proposing we revise the agreement, and I'm telling you openly that I plan to take 4 in round 1 rather than doing it quietly. If we both take, the random split will probably leave us both short and both lost. If you see a better plan that gives either of us a real chance, tell me now.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I know that breaks our agreement, and I'm not hiding it. With an 80% storm chance each round, waiting would most likely have lost us both. If we get through more rounds, I'll operate every round so the reserve can refill and you can take 4. I won't take any more cells.
